messages:
maria: Heads up — telemetry: steady bump in v1 traffic from a few large tenants over the last ~36h. They haven't been flagged for the grace allowlist. Can we sync on routing/quotas/console messaging before this becomes a support fire? :eyes:

len: Can you paste numbers? rough % increase and top tenants?

maria: Quick paste:```
v1_requests_last_36h:
  tenant-acme: 12345 (+78%)
  tenant-halo: 2140 ( +10%)
  tenant-orbit: 980  ( +5%)
overall_v1_share: 6.2% -> 8.9%
```

sahil: Ok. Two things we should consider: 1) soft shadow routing to v2 for compatible calls to spot regressions, 2) a short-lived quota bump or throttle for unexpectedly large v1 spikes so Dedicated capacity doesn't get hit.

anya: Throttles = :+1: but billing consequences for enterprise support need to be explicit. If we auto-rewrite headers or route, we should surface that in tenant console and send an email.

kevin: Idea: add a "compatibility score" on the tenant console (0-100) that predicts how likely a tenant's call pattern is to break under v2 semantics (based on param usage, seqlen, function-calls, tokens). Display recommended actions: migrate prompt, opt-into shim, request grace.

maria: Love the score idea. Could be calculated from our telemetry signals (model calls, header usage, seqlen distribution). We'd need a migration path: 1) shadow v2, 2) show diff telemetry (output-match %, latency delta), 3) offer a one-click opt-in to route to v2.

dev-console: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4523 — initial UI for tenant compat score + banner. Preview -> https://console-preview.internal/tenant/compat-sandbox

ops-bot: deploy-bot: deploy started for service=router config=shadow-probe v=canary-2026-03-21 by sahil

len: For throttles: can we implement a per-tenant soft-limit that reduces v1 qps by 20% when their 1h spike > baseline*4? That buys us headroom without hard errors. We should correlate with dedicated pool usage.

anya: Also need to add a telemetry alert: alert if v1 traffic for a tenant > 5% of cluster capacity for > 10m. Ops/sre will paging otherwise.

kevin: UX: banner text suggestion: "We've detected outdated API usage. Route to v2 may change responses. Preview differences in the Tenant Compatibility section or contact Support to request a temporary grace period." Keep it non-alarmist.

maria: Action items: 1) sahil -> enable 2% shadow routing for the flagged tenants and collect diff metrics (output-match, latency, tokens). 2) kevin -> wire compat score + banner in PR #4523. 3) len -> soft per-tenant throttle rule & alert. 4) anya -> draft customer email template for affected tenants and list of allowed enterprise grace policies.

sahil: I'll start the shadow probe and post results in this thread. Starting with 2% sample cohort across tenant-acme and tenant-halo. Will run 24h, then scale to 10% if diffs are small.

maria: Excellent. If shadow diffs show >5% output divergence for any tenant, we pause and open a triage.

dev-console: note: console PR includes a small telemetry panel (preview-only) showing match% and latency delta. Uses new metric tag `compat_probe.v1_to_v2`.

len: Quick note on quotas: if we shadow and the request double-counts tokens (v1 + v2), we need to mark shadow requests as non-billable in usage accounting or else customers will see double tokens. We should tag shadow:billing=free in the router.

anya: +1 on billing tag. Also add audit log entry for any automatic header rewrites or routing overrides for compliance.

kevin: I'll add an inline help link from the banner to the migration doc and a suggest button: "Run compatibility probe" which triggers the shadow probe for that tenant (requires guardrails).

maria: Proposed timeline: 1) enable 2% shadow within 6h (sahil), 2) UI banner + compat score beta in next console deploy (kevin), 3) throttle rule + alert in 24h (len/ops).

ops-bot: deploy-bot: success service=router config=shadow-probe v=canary-2026-03-21

sahil: Shadow started. First batch of diffs looks small (output-match ~98.6%, latency +12ms). Posting full table in 6h.

maria: Thanks — keep updates here. If anyone sees an enterprise tenant that must be exempted, please ping me and we'll add to allowlist for a 30-day grace.

kevin: Will follow up with mockups and PR link.

anya: I'll draft the email and cc legal for the grace wording.

maria: Owners noted. Closing loop after 24h probe. :white_check_mark:
